prompt: Who was the captain of the second mission that flew to the moon
response: The second crewed mission to the Moon was Apollo 8, which launched in December 1968. The captain (or Commander) of Apollo 8 was Frank Borman. Along with Borman were Lunar Module Pilot Jim Lovell and Command Module Pilot William Anders. They orbited the Moon but did not land, paving the way for the first lunar landing on Apollo 11.
